title: Life Cycle Hot Air Balloon Adventures

Up to 2-4 passengers per balloon; VIP private flights for 2 only

blurb: Guests fly approximately 50-90 minutes in a hot air balloon with 2-4 passengers per balloon. Flights include a traditional champagne style toast after landing. Flights operate from East Boulder County and other alternate launch areas.
extraNote: Reservations required, payment by major credit card or cash · Cancellations or changes 7 days or less before flight incur $100 per person fee · No penalty for cancellations more than 7 days before flight · No penalty if flight cancelled by operator due to weather; reschedule available · Gift certificates valid for one year, transferable, non-refundable · Launch sites in East Boulder County area, Frederick, Firestone, Dacono Colorado; address/map sent after reservation
